Remark
[Continuous differentiability of the flow] ↗ thm:semigroup-differential-properties 1. ch7:7.4.1-rem-1\group Semigroup Theory

If $u\in D(A)$, then $t\mapsto S(t)u$ is $C^1$ on $(0,\infty )$ because $AS(t)u=S(t)Au$ is continuous.
